kill_fact: No kill fact found. Every load-bearing bear claim verifies against primary filings, and the two that could have broken the thesis break the other way. (a) COST-CURVE TRUTH: the Q2 2026 release (2026-08-06) reports 209,115 GEO sold at a $568/GEO cash cost and a $3,875/GEO cash operating margin - the 10-Q arithmetic agrees ($241.3M cost of revenue less $122.8M non-cash depletion = $118.5M cash cost on $929.2M revenue = 12.8%, an 87.2% cash margin). The bear stipulates ~86% and is right; a streamer is at the bottom of the cost curve by construction and no cost-curve attack is available. (b) CONTRACT TRUTH: the Antamina terms the bear leans on are filed, not narrative - $4.3B upfront for BHP's 33.75% of payable silver until 100Moz delivered, then 22.5% for life of mine, ongoing payment 20% of spot, effective 2026-04-01 (company release 2026-02-16, SEC Form 6-K). Q2 Antamina silver of 2.3Moz on a partial quarter annualises to roughly the ~6.7Moz/yr the bear assumes, so the ~8% cash yield on $4.3B at $64.92 silver stands. (c) CYCLICAL-PEAK CHEAPNESS: this is the one trap the record cannot fall into, because it never claims cheapness - it claims the opposite, and the claim got stronger. At $133.43 the TTM EV/EBITDA is 22.4x on $62.4B EV, above the ~21x the record cites, so the name is dearer than when the bear was written, not cheaper. (d) HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER: none found. No impairment in the Q2 filing, 2026 guidance reaffirmed at 860,000-940,000 GEO, diluted share count 454,991k (flat, no dilution), no permit or reserve-downgrade disclosure, and the streams are genuine purchase agreements with a variable metal entitlement, not disguised debt. The balance-sheet attack that COULD have been a hidden disqualifier lands in the bear's favour: actual net debt at 2026-06-30 is $1,876.6M, WORSE than the ~$1.7B the record estimated, and the swing from $2,163.9M of net cash at 2026-03-31 is $4,040.5M, or $8.88/share rather than the ~$8.50 claimed. The thesis survives.
corrections: Four load-bearing numbers moved, all as a result of the record being written 2026-08-04, two days before the Q2 print it was waiting on. (1) PRICE ANCHOR STALE. The record prices the call off $115.99. WPM closed 2026-08-11 at $133.43, +15.0%, on the Q2 beat and a firmer metal tape. Every ratio in risk_reward is computed off a price that no longer exists. (2) BASE-CASE MARGIN ANCHOR UNDERSTATED. The base-case sum-of-the-parts assumes a realized $4,151/GEO against a $640/GEO cash cost, i.e. a $3,511/GEO cash margin. Q2 actuals print $4,443/GEO realized (=$929.2M / 209,115 GEO) against a $568/GEO cash cost, a $3,875/GEO margin - 10.4% above the record's assumption, and struck at metal prices BELOW today's spot (gold $4,437.30 and silver $64.92 on 2026-08-11 versus the record's $4,151 and $60.16 anchors). The record's own 'spot held flat' base case is therefore anchored to a stale spot AND an overstated unit cost. (3) NET DEBT UNDERSTATED. The record models minus $1.7B; the filed figure is minus $1,876.6M. Note the record also mis-splits the funding - actual drawn debt is $1,976.8M ($1.5B term loan plus $500M revolver), not the ~$2.4B / ~$0.9B revolver draw it describes - but cash fell all the way to $100.2M, so net debt is $177M worse despite less gross debt. The interest call was almost exact: Q2 finance costs $31.1M / interest expense $30.4M against Q1 net interest INCOME of $11.4M, versus the record's '~$30 million a quarter' estimate. (4) CATALYST STALE. catalyst_status reads PENDING_HARD for a 2026-08-06 event that has now fired; it is descriptive only and carries no verdict weight in this lane, but it should read FIRED. Carrying corrections (2) and (3) through the record's OWN schedule: base case part (1) becomes 900k GEO x $3,875 less $65M corporate = $3.42B capitalized at the record's own 15.5x = $53.1B; part (2) growth becomes 300k incremental GEO x $3,875, risk-adjusted 70% and discounted four years at 8%, x15.5, less the $1.3B committed = $8.0B; part (3) becomes minus $1.88B filed; part (4) becomes plus $0.19B (long-term investments $194.5M at 2026-06-30, up from the $54M the dossier flagged). Sum $59.3B / 454.99M diluted = $130 per share. The same margin correction carried into the record's own metal decks lifts the bull (gold $4,800 / silver $80, +27% torque, 18x) to ~$191, and lowers the bear (gold $3,200 / silver $38) to ~$56 - because rebuilding the bear cost stack from the FILED fixed/variable split (fixed ~$450/oz on ~415k gold ounces, 20% of spot on ~28Moz silver) yields ~$2.13B of operating earnings rather than the $2.32B assumed, and the bear's net debt starts $177M deeper. THE CALL SURVIVES ALL OF IT. At $133.43 against a corrected $130 base fair value the shares still trade AT or slightly THROUGH fair value with no structural floor, exactly as risk_reward argues - and the corrected distribution is worse, not better, for the buyer: minus 58% to the adverse case against plus 43% to the favourable one, versus the roughly symmetric spread the record describes. Caveat on precision: the bear and bull re-derivations depend on a gold/silver/other GEO mix inferred from reaffirmed 2026 guidance (400-430k gold oz, 27-29Moz silver) rather than a disclosed per-metal cost table, so treat those two levels as accurate to roughly plus or minus 5%; the base fair value and the net debt figure are filed-number arithmetic and are firm.
